lab_note: Lab observations came from one Windows 10 machine in October 2026; each measured item names its tested app version and observation date where recorded. Results may differ on other machines. Vendor windows are subject to the vendor's stated exceptions.

LAB-EXP001.label: SAF lab EXP-001: ChatGPT desktop Store package OpenAI.Codex 26.928, 2 October 2026, one run with daily follow-up

LAB-EXP003.label: SAF lab EXP-003: ChatGPT and Claude in Chrome 154, 3 October 2026, one run with daily follow-up

LAB-MARKS.label: SAF lab daily marks: ChatGPT desktop agent folder, daily checks from 2026-10-03

LAB-EXPORTS.label: SAF lab, October 2026: account exports were checked after chat deletion; export contents may vary by account

OPENAI-RETENTION.label: OpenAI Help: Deleting and archiving chats in ChatGPT (checked 23 October 2026; 30-day deletion schedule subject to security, legal and workspace exceptions)

ANTHROPIC-RETENTION.label: Anthropic Privacy Center: How long do you store my data? (checked 23 October 2026; consumer deleted chats removed from back-end storage within 30 days, subject to stated exceptions)

GOOGLE-GEMINI.label: Gemini Apps Help (checked 23 October 2026): personal-account activity auto-deletes after 18 months by default; setting and account type may differ

GOOGLE-CHROME.label: Google Chrome Help (checked 23 October 2026): History lists pages visited in the last 90 days; local file retention may differ

CLAUDE-CODE.label: Claude Code documentation (checked 24 October 2026): automatic deletion of local transcripts uses a retention setting, default 30 days

WIN-MOTW.label: Microsoft file-system specification: Zone.Identifier stream records a file's security zone; LUMINOL checks available source-URL fields

NOT-MEASURED.label: Not measured yet in the SAF lab

items.evidence: Prompt history kept by the ChatGPT desktop app
items.why: The ChatGPT desktop app can keep a typed-prompt record. LUMINOL reports its existence and age, not its text.

clock.note: In our lab, on ChatGPT desktop OpenAI.Codex 26.928, starting 2 October 2026, one run with daily checks: this file was present 15 days after in-app chat deletion.

items.action: Preserve this folder before the app is updated, reinstalled or uninstalled.
items.hold: Keep the ChatGPT desktop app installed. Do not update, reset or sign out of it until its folder (%USERPROFILE%\.codex) is preserved.

items.why: In the lab run, these app logs recorded when chats started.

clock.note: In our lab, on ChatGPT desktop OpenAI.Codex 26.928, starting 2 October 2026, one run with daily checks: a log line was present at 14.0 days and gone at 14.1 days. Age versus size rotation was not measured.

items.action: Preserve before the app is updated or reinstalled.
items.hold: Do not delete or clear the app's log folders (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Codex\Logs and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\OpenAI.Codex_*\LocalCache\Local\Codex\Logs).

items.why: Agent sessions and their replies stored on disk.

clock.note: Lifetime not measured for a recorded app version. Treat these files as at risk while threads can be deleted, archived or cleared in the app.

items.action: Preserve this folder before a thread is deleted in the app.
items.hold: Do not delete, archive or clear agent threads in the Codex app, and keep the %USERPROFILE%\.codex folder as it is.

items.why: This agent log database can contain requests, commands and times.

clock.note: Lifetime not measured for a recorded app version. Treat these files as at risk while threads can be deleted, archived or cleared in the app.

items.action: Preserve this file now, before any agent thread is deleted.
items.hold: Do not delete, archive or clear agent threads in the Codex app, and keep the %USERPROFILE%\.codex folder as it is.

items.why: These databases can contain agent-thread records, commands, folders and times.

clock.note: Lifetime not measured for a recorded app version. Treat these files as at risk while threads can be deleted, archived or cleared in the app.

items.action: Preserve these files now, before any agent thread is deleted.
items.hold: Do not delete, archive or clear agent threads in the Codex app, and keep the %USERPROFILE%\.codex folder as it is.

items.why: App storage for the Claude desktop app.
items.action: Preserve before the app is updated or uninstalled.
items.hold: Keep the Claude desktop app installed. Do not reset, sign out of or uninstall it.

items.why: Full transcripts of coding-agent sessions, per project.

clock.note: Claude Code docs say local transcripts older than the configured retention period are deleted automatically when the period can be determined; the default is 30 days. Check the local setting.

items.action: Preserve transcripts before automatic deletion can remove them.
items.hold: Do not delete Claude Code transcripts (%USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects). Preserve them before automatic deletion can remove them.

items.evidence: Cursor editor chat and agent store
items.why: This Cursor data store may contain AI chat and agent history.
items.action: Preserve before Cursor is updated or reset.
items.hold: Do not reset Cursor or clear its chat or agent history.

items.tool: VS Code AI agents (Cline, Roo, Kilo)
items.why: These extension task folders may contain agent conversations.
items.action: Preserve before the extension is removed.
items.hold: Do not remove the VS Code AI agent extensions or clear their task history.

items.tool: Local AI (Ollama, LM Studio, GPT4All, Jan, AnythingLLM)
items.why: These folders may contain local models and saved chat threads. Data processed locally can still be evidence.
items.action: Preserve before the app or its models are removed.
items.hold: Do not delete local AI apps, their models or their saved chats.

items.why: Shows which listed AI site names appear in the browser history files it could read. A match does not prove what a person viewed or said.

clock.note: Google's Chrome Help says its History lists the last 90 days. That page does not establish how long a local History file retains every visit; Edge, Brave and Firefox were not separately measured.

items.action: Preserve the browser profile; older visits drop off every day.
items.hold: Do not clear browsing history, cookies or site data in any browser profile on this computer.

items.why: Can hold recent prompt and reply text from claude.ai.

clock.note: In our lab, on Chrome 154, 3 October 2026, one run: test text was present at 0.7 days and absent by 1.2 days.

items.action: Text from the last day may still be here: preserve today.
items.hold: Do not clear site data for claude.ai.

items.why: A local storage folder can exist without chat text. In one Chrome 154 lab run on 3 October 2026, deleted-chat text was absent.

clock.note: In our lab, on Chrome 154, 3 October 2026, one run: deleted-chat text was not found in the checked local storage.

items.action: Do not rely on it: request the account export (below).
items.hold: Do not clear site data for chatgpt.com.

items.why: Notification history can include the first words of an AI reply.

clock.note: In our lab, on ChatGPT desktop OpenAI.Codex 26.928, starting 2 October 2026, one run: a notification was present at 2.4 days and absent by 3.9 days.

items.action: Notifications from the last 2 days may still exist: preserve today.

items.why: Some downloaded files carry a Windows source-site mark. LUMINOL reports a match when that mark names a listed AI site.

clock.note: A source-site mark may remain while the file stays in place. Moving or copying it can remove the mark.

items.action: Keep these files where they are; copying them can drop the mark.
items.hold: Do not delete or move files downloaded from AI sites (Downloads, Desktop, Documents).

items.why: Recently opened-file shortcuts may identify documents to review. They do not show whether a document was uploaded or pasted into an AI tool.

clock.note: In our lab on Windows 10, starting 2 October 2026, one run with daily checks: test-document shortcuts were present after 15 days. Other Windows builds may differ.

items.action: Preserve; Windows replaces old entries as new files are opened.
items.hold: Do not clear Windows' list of recently opened files.

items.evidence: Chats stored in the ChatGPT account
items.why: The account may hold conversation records that this local check cannot inspect.

clock.note: OpenAI says a deleted chat is scheduled for permanent deletion within 30 days, subject to security, legal and workspace exceptions. Temporary Chats have separate rules. OpenAI says deleted chats cannot be restored in ChatGPT or through Support; request an export before deletion.

items.action: Request an account export now (ChatGPT > Settings > Data controls > Export data) and download it within 24 hours of the email.
items.hold: Do not delete or archive ChatGPT chats, use Temporary Chat, change Data controls, or close the account. Request an account export now.

items.evidence: Chats stored in the Claude account
items.why: The account may hold conversation records that this local check cannot inspect.

clock.note: Anthropic says a deleted consumer conversation is removed from back-end storage within 30 days, subject to its stated exceptions. Work and API accounts have separate terms.

items.action: Request an account export now (Claude > Settings > Privacy > Export data) and download it when it arrives.
items.hold: Do not delete Claude conversations or projects, change privacy settings, or close the account. Request an account export now.

items.evidence: Gemini Apps Activity in the Google account
items.why: With Keep Activity on, a personal Google account stores Gemini Apps activity; this local check cannot inspect it.

clock.note: Google says personal Gemini Apps activity auto-deletes after 18 months by default; the setting can be changed. With Keep Activity off, a chat may remain with the account for up to 72 hours. Work accounts differ.

items.action: Check the Gemini Activity auto-delete setting and export with Google Takeout now.
items.hold: Do not delete Gemini Apps Activity or shorten its auto-delete period. Export it with Google Takeout now.

cannot_answer: Whether browser history or files were cleared or deleted before this check. A cleared history looks the same to LUMINOL as one with no AI visits. A forensic triage can look for signs of clearing.
What was typed or answered. LUMINOL checks where evidence exists and when it was last changed without reading conversation text.
What the AI vendors still hold beyond their published policies. Business and enterprise plans can have different retention.
Other devices (phones, home computers), other Windows accounts, and browsers not used by this Windows account.
Apps and sites not in this version's list.
What an AI agent did through Windows' own records (the file-system change journal and Prefetch). LUMINOL does not inspect these records; an administrator collection may be needed.
Exact lifetimes on this machine: lab observations came from one Windows 10 machine, with app versions recorded for some items.
